newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet selloff unlikely by March - Stajano.
newsitem.headline: Stet selloff unlikely by March - Stajano.

text.p: ROME, Oct 25 - The privatisation of state telecoms holding company Stet is unlikely to get under way in time to meet the government's end-March deadline, a member of a parliamentary commission said on Thursday.
Ernesto Stajano, chairman of the lower house's transport and telecommunications committee said there was a risk that the privatisation would have to be postponed until October, 1997.
"I don't think we will be in time to carry out the privatisation of Stet between February and March, even though I hope it does not turn out like that," Stajano told reporters at a conference.

Stajano said that if the upper house of parliament, the Senate, failed to approve legislation setting up an authority to regulate the telecoms industry before the 1997 budget goes to parliament there would be a risk of a delay.
The lower house has to approve the 1997 budget by November 18 before it can go to the senate.

Stet faces stiff competition for the attention of international investors from Deutsche Telekom, whose giant flotation gets under way next month, and from France Telecom, slated for privatisation next year.
